description: Rajasthan HC seeks AI education plans and screen-time limits, warning that tech dependence could reshape children’s learning.
body_lead: Read the original order here: [PDF] Rajasthan High Court’s Justice Anoop Kumar Dhand has taken suo moto cognizance of the welfare and future of “Generation Z, Generation Alpha and Generation Beta,” directing the Centre and State to file comprehensive action plans on AI and digital technology integration and screen-time limits, while expressing concern over how AI is changing children’s learning behaviour.
